modelOverview: The Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Perpetual Calendar houses one of the manufacture's flagship complications within the collection's distinctive round-case, octagonal-middle architecture and double-curved sapphire crystal. It displays day, date, month, week, leap year and an astronomical moon, all governed by a self-winding movement. The line pairs traditional watchmaking depth with contemporary, sculptural case design.

26394OR.OO.D321CR.01.movement: Automatic · Audemars Piguet Calibre 5134 · ~40h power reserve
26394OR.OO.D321CR.01.materials: 18-carat pink gold case on a blue alligator leather strap with 18-carat pink gold folding clasp
26394OR.OO.D321CR.01.bezel: 18-carat pink gold with lacquered blue inner bezel
26394OR.OO.D321CR.01.dial: Blue aventurine dial and subdials with 18-carat pink gold applied hour-markers and hands
26394OR.OO.D321CR.01.description: The Code 11.59 Perpetual Calendar in pink gold showcases a shimmering blue aventurine dial that gives the classic perpetual-calendar layout a deep, star-flecked backdrop. It runs the self-winding Calibre 5134, displaying day, date, week, month, leap year and an astronomical moon, all framed by the collection's octagonal-middle case and double-curved sapphire crystal. Each example is individually sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.Rose Gold: The pink (rose) gold edition, reference 26394OR.OO.D321CR.01, features a 41mm 18-carat pink gold case and a blue aventurine dial with matching lacquered blue inner bezel, worn on a hand-stitched blue alligator strap with 18-carat pink gold folding clasp. It pairs the full perpetual-calendar display of Calibre 5134 with a warm gold case and cosmic aventurine dial, and is individually sourced and authenticated.
